Review and close interrupted document access

Choose the document yourself in Android’s picker. Jarvys’s automated device access stays blocked until this interaction is explicitly closed. Jarvys does not read the document. The verified app receives only temporary access to your selection. Only the latest exactly signed APK is supported.
I closed the old picker and task; acknowledge and close

The previous interaction was interrupted. No selection or authority can be recovered. First close any old Android document picker and its app task. Jarvys cannot verify their closure. Your acknowledgment only releases the automation boundary; the old outcome remains unknown.
